invariants.preparation: Preparation is pure and registry-independent. It accepts an explicit target version and source commit, changes only package version and agentera.gitRef, and leaves the diff for review and commit.
invariants.sourceQualification: Source qualification never repairs source. It issues a content-addressed receipt only after every declared source gate succeeds against a clean committed tree. A matching receipt is a deterministic local cache, not an authorization boundary.
invariants.candidateQualification: Candidate qualification validates a current source receipt, constructs one retained immutable tarball with the contract-required retained mode, proves dry-pack observation equivalence, and runs a local exact-artifact smoke in an empty isolated npm state before any registry effect.
invariants.publication: Registry publication consumes the retained candidate bytes. It stages an absent exact version on its candidate tag, runs exact-version checks before promotion, then moves the expected tag forward. It never reconstructs an artifact or rolls a tag back.
invariants.approval: Registry mutation requires an explicit approval bound to the candidate receipt digest, target version, integrity, package, registry, and tag. A branch push is never approval.
invariants.replay: A matching exact version, integrity, and required tag state is a successful no-upload replay. Conflicting integrity, an escaped artifact, a stale tag, or any unrecognized registry state fails before mutation.
invariants.credentials: Registry inspection runs before credentials are required. Only the npm mutation child receives a mode-0600 temporary user config. Tool probes and every npm, pnpm, and npx child, including receipt validation during stage and promotion, use isolated user/global config, home, cache, and sanitized npm/pnpm environments.
invariants.output: Every phase emits a bounded start and end result with package, version, phase, outcome, elapsedMs, executed, reused, and nextAction. JSON is one object per line; human output carries the same fields. Diagnostics redact credentials and private absolute paths.

sourceProvenance.rule: agentera.gitRef must name a commit with exactly the current shim packaged inputs. Only package.json version and agentera.gitRef may differ because preparation owns those fields.

source.parallelism: sequential: source, stress, performance, package, generated-overlap, typecheck, build, compact, and capability-contract share checkout-generated output or policy barriers. No owner has a declared isolated output root with equivalence evidence, so source qualification preserves ordered production evidence. The benchmark coordinator measures the whole source-plus-candidate envelope; a timeout is not performance evidence.

trust.local: A same-principal source receipt is a deterministic cache only. It cannot authorize registry mutation.
trust.ci: CI registry mutation requires the transferred exact artifact and receipts, a CI attestation bound to the candidate receipt and source run, and an explicit candidate-bound approval. OIDC provenance is deferred.

registryStateTable.stage: replay without upload and run observational smoke
registryStateTable.promote: move expected tag forward after exact-version qualification

registryStateTable.exactVersion: missing, changed, conflicting, or tag ahead

benchmark.environment: Ubuntu runner or clean local Node 22, npm 10, and pnpm 10.30.3; record exact tool versions in receipts.
benchmark.fixture: clean committed checkout and an external empty candidate directory; no tracked or checkout-local generated candidate files.
benchmark.cacheNetwork: Preflight uses no registry call. Qualification and each smoke use a new empty HOME, npm cache, user config, and global config; public npm dependency network access is allowed and recorded as cold-cache. Publication reads the registry before credentials.
benchmark.statistic: median elapsed milliseconds over exactly three cold-cache repetitions; the executable coordinator records every phase and owner duration, executed/reused state, and reconciled phase totals.
benchmark.coordinator: packages/cli/scripts/release-benchmark.mjs runs preflight and source-plus-candidate qualification only. It never receives npm credentials or invokes registry mutation. It can enforce the qualified-publication bound only for separately recorded approved transaction timing; that transaction is never invoked by the qualification benchmark.
benchmark.failureRule: The first failing owner is emitted immediately, remains the reported failure label, and cancels later ordered work. No timeout or failure authorizes repair or registry mutation.
